sections.text_helper: Section 39.7.8 "Chroma down-sampling" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1867.
sections.section_content:
The Chroma down-sampling module reduces the chroma resolution from its arriving
YUV444 format to the potential YUV420 output, and sends them to a different channel.
Features
• Downsizes in H first, if YUV420, with (0.5 + 0.5) filter
• Downsizes in V then, if YUV420, with (0.5 + 0.5) filter
• Memory: embeds one half-line buffer for each U and V
Software configuration
Configuration is indirectly taken from the pixel packing output format, located in the
DCMIPP_PxPPCR register.
• The Chroma down-sampling is active when the output pixel format is YUV422-1,
YUV422-2, YUV420-2, YUV420-3.
Output
• One to three channels: RGB/Y, UV (or U) and V.
